title: 3 Common Hazard Light Mistakes Every Driver Makes
hook: Stop using your hazard lights wrong.

script.narration: Stop using your hazard lights wrong.
script.visual_search: car hazard lights flashing on rainy highway

script.narration: First, never turn them on while driving in heavy rain because cars behind you cannot see your actual brake lights. Second, do not use them to park illegally on busy streets just for a quick errand. Third, avoid running them while towing unless required by law.
script.visual_search: driver turning on dashboard hazard switch

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. When do you use hazards? Comment below.

description:
Are you using your car hazard lights incorrectly? Learn three common mistakes new and experienced drivers make with their emergency flashers. Knowing the proper rules keeps everyone safer on the road.
